units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12<sup>11</sup></cite> <he>עד שלא הוקם … היה העולם רוֹתֵת וכ׳</he> before the Tabernacle was erected, the world was unstable, opp. <cite ref="B01007"><he>נתבסס</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B01007"><he>בָּסַס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sotah 8a:6">Sot. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>איכא בינייהו רוֹתֶתֶת</he> the practical difference between them exists in the event of her trembling (when it is not to be apprehended that she may become defiant in the presence of another woman); <he>ורותתת מי משקין</he> but even if she trembles, dare we permit two women to take the test simultaneously?
<cite ref="Chullin 24b:2">Ḥull. 24ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>עד שיזקין</he>) <he>עד שיְרַתֵּת</he> until he trembles (from old age).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>כיון שנברא … מְרַתְּתִים</he> when iron was created, the trees began to tremble; <he>אמר להן למה אתם מרתתים וכ׳</he> said the iron to them, why do you tremble, allow no wood to be put into me, &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <he>היה מְרַתֵּת על עצמו</he> he began to tremble for his own safety.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29">Ex. R. s. 29</cite> <he>ההר מרתת</he> the mountain shook.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29">Ib.</cite> <he>נתנה מקום והיתה מְרַתֶּתֶת</he> she made room (for the king) and trembled; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T01147">same</cite>. Ib. <he>וישראל מַרְתִּיתִין</he> and the Israelites trembled.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> <he>והיה … עומד ומַרְתִּית וכ׳</he> and the servant stood before the king trembling.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>למה אתה מרתית</he> (some ed. <he>מְרַתֵּת</he>) why dost thou tremble?; a. e.
